name: Tarrazú coffee
where: Café Britt official shop or Caféoteca
about: This coffee is grown in the Tarrazú highlands, one of Costa Rica's best-known growing regions.
tip: Check the origin and roast date on the bag.

name: Boruca mask
about: This carved mask comes from the Boruca indigenous community and is a traditional Costa Rican craft.
tip: Ask the seller about the artist and confirm the mask is hand-carved.

name: Salsa Lizano
about: This mild, savory sauce is made in Costa Rica and is common on local tables.
tip: Check the bottle size on the label before buying.
